## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When this story is complete, running /dso:respond-to-pr-comments <PR-URL-or-number> fetches all unresolved comments, classifies them, dispatches handlers, and prints a summary table of comment ID, classification, and action taken
- DD2: When this story is complete, the skill prints "No unresolved comments found on PR #<n>." when pr-comment-response.sh returns an empty comments array
- DD3: When this story is complete, the embedded classification prompt classifies comments as accept, defend, or defer using the defined criteria; ambiguous comments default to defer; for defend cases, the prompt outputs both the classification label and the defense argument text

## Overview
Create the /dso:respond-to-pr-comments skill entry point. This skill:
1. Parses the PR URL or number from arguments
2. Invokes pr-comment-response.sh to fetch and normalize all unresolved comments
3. Applies an embedded LLM classification prompt to each comment
4. Dispatches the accept/defend/defer handler for each comment
5. Prints a summary table of comment ID, classification, and action taken
6. Prints "No unresolved comments found on PR #<n>." when no comments found

## File Impact
- CREATE: plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md

## Implementation Notes

### Skill file location
plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md

### Frontmatter
```yaml
---
name: respond-to-pr-comments
description: Fetches all unresolved PR comments, classifies each as accept/defend/defer, dispatches the appropriate handler, and prints a summary table. Trigger: /dso:respond-to-pr-comments <PR-URL-or-number>.
user-invocable: true
allowed-tools: Read, Bash, Glob, Grep
---
```

### PR number/URL parsing
The skill accepts either:
- A PR URL: https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123 → extract 123
- A PR number: 123 (plain integer)
If no argument provided, print usage and stop.

### Fetch step
Call pr-comment-response.sh to fetch and normalize comments:
```bash
TMP_OUTPUT=$(mktemp /tmp/dso-pr-comments.XXXXXX.json)
bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh" \
  --pr-number <N> --output "$TMP_OUTPUT"
```
Read the output JSON and extract the comments array.

### No-comments handling
If the comments array is empty:
```
No unresolved comments found on PR #<N>.
```
Clean up temp file and stop.

### Classification prompt
For each unresolved comment (already_replied=false), apply this classification:

Classify the following PR comment as accept, defend, or defer:

**Classification criteria**:
- accept: The reviewer is requesting a specific, actionable code change. The comment describes something that should be fixed or improved in the code.
- defend: The existing design is justifiable with codebase evidence. The comment questions a design decision that has a clear rationale based on the codebase, architecture, or project constraints.
- defer: The comment is out-of-scope, ambiguous, not actionable, or blocked on external dependencies. Default for any ambiguous case.

**For defend classifications**: In addition to the classification label, produce a defense argument text — a codebase-backed justification explaining why the current design is correct. This text will be posted as the defense response.

### Handler dispatch
After classifying each comment, call pr-comment-response.sh with --classify-as flags:
```bash
bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh" \
  --pr-number <N> --output "$TMP_OUTPUT" \
  --classify-as <comment_id>:accept \
  --classify-as <comment_id>:defend \
  --classify-as <comment_id>:defer
```
(Include only the --classify-as flags for comments that need handling)

For defend comments, update the JSON body field with the defense argument text before calling the handler, so the defend handler uses the LLM-generated defense text instead of the placeholder.

### Summary table
After all handlers run, print:
```
## PR Comment Response Summary

| Comment ID | Classification | Action Taken |
|------------|----------------|--------------|
| <id>       | accept         | Committed and replied |
| <id>       | defend         | Posted defense comment |
| <id>       | defer          | Created ticket |
```

### Concurrent invocation note
Include a note: Concurrent invocations on the same PR may double-process comments — the <!-- dso-agent-reply --> sentinel deduplicates sequential runs but not concurrent ones.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md
- [ ] Skill contains "No unresolved comments found on PR #" message pattern
  Verify: grep -q "No unresolved comments found on PR #" plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md
- [ ] Skill contains accept, defend, defer classification criteria
  Verify: grep -q "accept" plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md && grep -q "defend" plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md && grep -q "defer" plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md
- [ ] Skill contains summary table with comment ID, classification, action taken columns
  Verify: grep -q "Comment ID" plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md && grep -q "Classification" plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md && grep -q "Action Taken" plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md
- [ ] Structural tests from Task 1 pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-respond-to-pr-comments-skill.sh
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
